allowed_private_runtime_plugins.purpose: Semantic mediation for explicit owner proactive quiet/resume, audible speech mute/unmute, autonomous-screen privacy intent, plus read-only retrospective activity recall from ActivityWatch.
allowed_private_runtime_plugins.acceptance_gap: Live use required natural-language intent to become deterministic controls, and retrospective questions such as 'what did I do over the last hour' needed a queryable activity source without duplicating a new activity datastore.
